misc-sim-01-c3.text: Nick Bostrom (2003). The Simulation Argument. simulation-argument.com.
misc-sim-01-c3.quote: we currently lack grounds for eliminating either of the three disjuncts
misc-sim-01-c3.claim: He argues that at least one of (1), (2), or (3) must be true, and that we don't currently have strong evidence ruling any out.
